text: わたしたち　いま　あなたの　うわさを　していたのよ　さいきん　すごい　つよい　トレーナーが　あらわれた　って！

structure.jp: わたしたち　いま　あなたの　うわさを　していたのよ
structure.en: we were just talking about you

structure.jp: さいきん　すごい　つよい　トレーナーが　あらわれた　って！
structure.en: saying an incredibly strong Trainer has appeared lately!

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って here is the casual form of と and shows that what comes before it is what people were saying. あらわれた　って = 'saying that one has appeared'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ていた after a verb says the action was going on at that time. うわさを　していた = 'we were gossiping'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end is a soft, often feminine form of のだ, used when you are explaining something. していたの = 'we were doing it, you see'.
